# What is Zipchat AI

<figure><img src="/files/X2VWrSY09tzf7cxsFyOB" alt=""><figcaption><p>AI Chatbot for Ecommerce</p></figcaption></figure>

### **What Is Zipchat AI**

**Zipchat AI** is an **AI Agent for eCommerce** — a next-generation system that helps **Shopify and online stores** sell more, support faster, and communicate smarter.\
It combines an **AI Chatbot**, **AI Sales Assistant**, and **WhatsApp Marketing Agent** into one platform that works automatically across your website and WhatsApp.

***

#### **Why Zipchat AI Exists**

Most eCommerce stores lose sales because customers leave before buying or can’t get quick answers.\
Traditional chatbots fail because they reply with scripted, generic messages that don’t actually help.

**Zipchat AI** was created to solve this.\
It acts like a **real sales agent powered by AI** — understanding your products, store data, and customer behavior to give **personalized, real-time conversations** that guide visitors to checkout.

***

#### **The Core Missions of Zipchat AI**

**🤑 1. Sell More**

Zipchat detects buying intent and starts conversations automatically.\
It answers pre-sale questions, suggests the right products, and helps visitors complete their purchase — turning traffic into revenue.

**🤝 2. Support Smarter**

It handles 24/7 support on both your **website chat** and **WhatsApp**, instantly resolving common issues like order tracking, returns, or FAQs.\
This keeps customers happy while reducing support workload.

**📊 3. Learn and Improve**

Every interaction teaches the AI more about your audience.\
It identifies what customers ask most, what stops them from buying, and what products convert best — giving you **actionable insights** to improve your store and marketing.

***

#### **The Zipchat AI Difference**

With Zipchat, you don’t just add a chatbot.\
You deploy a **fully trained AI Sales Agent** that:

* Works across chat and WhatsApp automatically
* Learns from your catalog, FAQs, and support data
* Delivers **1-to-1 customer experiences at scale**
* Helps brands **increase conversions and reduce cart abandonment**

***

**Zipchat AI** turns your eCommerce store into a living, learning sales system — one that sells, supports, and grows smarter every day.

# Why Choose Zipchat AI?

<figure><img src="/files/yakQ7syiNiXswAvVTUac" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

Zipchat AI isn’t just another chatbot – it’s your secret weapon for growing your e-commerce business. Here’s why it’s a must-have for any online store:

***

### 1. **Turn Visitors into Buyers 🤑**

Zipchat helps you convert curious browsers into paying customers by answering questions, offering recommendations, and addressing concerns in real time. It’s proven to reduce cart abandonment and boost conversions – with users seeing up to 5x more sales from hesitant shoppers.

<figure><img src="/files/LtUtPcZnOirWB8neDjXz" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

***

### 2. **Proactively Engages Shoppers 😎**

Unlike traditional chatbots, Zipchat doesn’t sit back and wait. It starts the conversation, offering help or nudging customers to act based on their behavior. For example, if someone lingers on a product page, it might suggest similar items or explain benefits, keeping them engaged.

<figure><img src="/files/ftCrYQ4WUJVmPKZ3cwjN" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

***

### 3. **Always On, Always Ready 😈**

Your customers shop at all hours, and Zipchat is ready 24/7. Whether it’s answering a question about a product, helping track an order, or solving a problem, Zipchat ensures customers always get the support they need – no waiting, no frustration.

***

### 4. **Works Seamlessly with Shopify 🛍️**

If you’re on Shopify, you’re in luck. Zipchat syncs directly with your store’s catalog, giving customers real-time info about products, pricing, or availability. It’s a smooth setup, too – no plugins, no hassle.

Not on Shopify? Absolutely not problem. You can copy/paste a simple line of code and Zipchat is ready to be activated on your store.

***

### 5. **Drives More Sales 📈**

Zipchat doesn’t just chat – it sells. Its Proactive Chat feature sends targeted messages at key moments, like offering a discount when someone hesitates at checkout. These gentle nudges can turn “maybe” into “yes” faster than you think.

Versatility is at our core, build whatever logic you like with Zipchat.

***

### 6. **Speaks Your Customers’ Language 🤟**

Zipchat supports 95+ languages, so it’s perfect for today businesses.  Whether your audience is in Paris, Tokyo, or São Paulo, Zipchat makes sure they feel understood and valued.

Selling only to one country? Consider this. Thanks to globalization, expats are everywhere. Make sure to speak to them too.

***

### 7. **Gives You Data That Matters 👨‍💻**

What are your customers asking? What’s stopping them from buying? Zipchat doesn’t just handle chats – it tracks trends and reveals insights that help you improve your website, marketing, and sales strategies.

***

### 8. **Quick to Set Up, Easy to Customize 🍳**

No tech wizardry required! You can have Zipchat running in minutes. Match it to your brand’s colors, style, and tone. Add custom chat triggers and watch it fit perfectly into your business.

***

### 9. **Grows with Your Business 🚀**

From small startups to bustling enterprises, Zipchat scales with you. Whether you need it to handle a few chats a day or thousands during a Black Friday rush, it’s built to keep up without breaking a sweat.

***

### 10. **Boosts ROI from Day One ✅**

Most users start seeing sales directly from Zipchat during their free trial. It’s not just a tool; it’s an investment that pays for itself – fast.

***

### Ready to level up your e-commerce game?

Zipchat AI is the perfect blend of smart technology and customer-first service, designed to help you sell more, stress less, and grow faster. Don’t let your visitors slip away – let Zipchat turn them into loyal customers today.&#x20;


# AppSumo Hub

AppSumo License: Redeem, Activate & Get Started

Welcome, Sumo-ling! 👋

You just grabbed Zipchat AI on AppSumo. Great choice. This guide walks you through every step to redeem your license, create your account, and launch your first AI agent. The whole process takes about 3 minutes.

***

### Step 1: Find Your Zipchat AI Purchase on AppSumo

Log in to your [AppSumo account](https://zipchat.click/appsumo-deal) and head to **Products**.

You can get there in two ways:

* Click **Products** in the left sidebar, or
* Click your profile icon in the top-right corner and select **Products** from the dropdown menu.

You'll see **Zipchat AI (License Tier 1)** listed under your active products.

![Find Zipchat AI in your AppSumo Products page](/files/sWivK9rXnTSVBRhuEq7X)

***

### Step 2: Open the Activation Page

From the Products page, click **"Activate now"** next to your Zipchat AI purchase.

This takes you to the **Activate your purchase** page for Zipchat AI.

> ⏰ **Important:** You must activate your license before the deadline shown (e.g., March 21, 2026). After that date, the license expires and can no longer be activated.

![Click Activate now to begin](/files/KIYJuyVYGPevF1cwTPvJ)

***

### Step 3: Choose Add-Ons (Optional)

Before activating, you'll see an **Available add-ons** section. These are completely optional. You can skip them and activate with just your base license.

The available add-ons include:

* **Remove "Powered by Zipchat" branding** for +$99 (one-time)
* **Website deployments** at $125 per 25 extra website deployments (up to 100)
* **Extra monthly pages** at $50 per 10,000 extra pages (up to 40,000)

> ⚠️ Add-ons are **non-refundable**, so only purchase them if you're sure you need them. You can always add them later.

If you don't need any add-ons, just ignore this section.

![Available add-ons section](/files/X4J3HMsV59N0Lj6Kidko)

***

### Step 4: Click "Activate Now"

Once you're ready, click the yellow **"Activate now"** button on the activation page.

A popup will appear with an important message:

> **Before you activate:** Please make sure you're **logged out of all existing accounts on the Zipchat AI website**. This ensures your AppSumo license is correctly attached to the right account and prevents activation issues. 👀

If you've never used Zipchat before, you're good to go. Just click **"Activate"**.

If you already have a Zipchat account, open a new tab, go to [app.zipchat.ai](https://app.zipchat.ai/), log out first, then come back and click **"Activate"**.

> **Note:** you cannot activate an AppSumo licence on an account or store previosly activated on Zipchat. Since the deal is limited and for new client only, you need a new account and a new store/site.

![Before you activate: log out warning](/files/FlZO2IfuTfzwzzwRa8E0)

***

### Step 5: Allow AppSumo to Connect with Zipchat AI

After clicking Activate, a permissions dialog will appear asking you to let **Zipchat AI read your AppSumo license key**.

This is standard and safe. It simply allows Zipchat to verify your purchase and set up your account with the correct plan.

Click **"Allow"** to continue.

![Allow Zipchat AI to access your AppSumo license](/files/2y0keQ7xvHwxdkBJ98t1)

***

### Step 6: Create Your Zipchat AI Account

You'll land on the **Zipchat + AppSumo** signup page.

Fill in:

* **Email** : Use the email you want for your Zipchat account (you'll need to confirm it).
* **Password** : Minimum 8 characters (12 recommended for best security).
* **Confirm Password** : Re-enter the same password.

Then click **"Sign up"**.

Your AppSumo license will be automatically linked to this new account. No codes or keys to enter.

![Create your Zipchat AI account](/files/XJqV7JMsBYfW0szW47HW)

***

### Step 7: Create Your First AI Agent

After signing up, you'll be taken to your **Zipchat dashboard**.

Click the **"Create agent"** button on the right side of the screen.

![Click Create agent on the dashboard](/files/xJhKoWOAh2ylAKptYd15)

A dialog will appear asking for your **website URL**. Enter the full URL of your online store (e.g., `https://yourwebsite.com`) and click **"Create"**.

Zipchat will immediately start crawling your website to build the AI's knowledge base, learning about your products, pages, and content so it can start helping your customers right away.

![Enter your website URL to create your AI agent](/files/PmUBjqBcbgiFp40fh3rQ)

***

### 🎉 That's It. You're Live!

Your AI agent is now being created and trained on your website data. From here, you can:

* [**Customize your chat widget**](https://docs.zipchat.ai/installation-and-setup/chat-settings/channels/bubble-chat-edit-design) to match your brand
* [**Train your AI agent**](https://docs.zipchat.ai/installation-and-setup/ai-training/knowledge-base) with additional knowledge (PDFs, FAQs, custom instructions)
* **Install the chat script** on your website, **Account > Chat Settings > Scripts & Integrations**
* **Test your chatbot** to make sure everything works perfectly

For a complete walkthrough of all features, check out the [**Product Full Demo**](https://docs.zipchat.ai/product-full-demo) or the [**3-Minute Interactive Demo**](https://docs.zipchat.ai/3-minutes-interactive-demo).

***

### Managing Your AppSumo License

You can manage your Zipchat AI license anytime from your [AppSumo Products page](https://appsumo.com/account/products/).

Click the **"Select"** dropdown next to your Zipchat AI purchase to access these options:

* **Redemption information** : View details about your license and activation status
* **View invoice** : Download your purchase receipt
* **Product details** : See the full product listing page
* **Refund** : Request a refund (see below)

![Manage your license from the Select dropdown](https://claude.ai/chat/screenshot-9-dropdown.png)

***

#### How to Purchase Add-Ons After Activation

If you skipped add-ons during activation and want to grab them later, here's how:

1. Go to your [AppSumo Products page](https://appsumo.com/account/products/).
2. Click **"Select"** next to Zipchat AI.
3. Select **"Redemption information"** or visit the activation page.
4. Scroll down to **"Available add-ons"**.
5. Select the add-ons you want and complete the purchase.

Add-ons are linked to your license tier and will be automatically activated in your Zipchat account.

> Remember: Add-ons are **non-refundable**, so make sure you need them before purchasing.

***

#### How to Request a Refund

Your AppSumo purchase is backed by a **60-day money-back guarantee**. If Zipchat isn't the right fit, here's how to request a refund:

1. Go to your [AppSumo Products page](https://appsumo.com/account/products/).
2. Click **"Select"** next to Zipchat AI.
3. Select **"Refund"** from the dropdown.
4. Follow the prompts to complete your refund request.

You can also visit the [AppSumo Help Center](https://help.appsumo.com/) for more information about refund policies and timelines.

> **Note:** Refunds are eligible through the date shown on your activation page (e.g., "Eligible through March 21, 2026"). Add-ons purchased separately are non-refundable.

***

### Need Help?

If you run into any issues during activation or setup:

* **Chat with us** on the bottom-right of [zipchat.ai](https://zipchat.ai/) or inside the app
* **Email us** at <support@zipchat.ai>
* **Contact Zipchat AI** from your AppSumo activation page
* **Contact AppSumo Support** for billing or license issues
* **Browse the docs** right here at [docs.zipchat.ai](https://docs.zipchat.ai/)

Welcome aboard. We're excited to have you! 🚀

# Dashboard

The Zipchat AI Dashboard is your command center for tracking how well your chatbot is performing and how it’s contributing to your business. It’s designed to give you quick, actionable insights into key metrics so you can optimize and grow. Here’s what you’ll find:

***

### Key Metrics at a Glance

<figure><img src="/files/t6P2tCo76jN4UeoihozT" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

1. **Sales including a conversation**\
   See exactly how much revenue your chatbot has helped generate. This metric shows the direct impact of Zipchat on your bottom line.
2. **Total Orders**\
   Track how many orders came from customers who interacted with your chatbot. It’s a clear indicator of how Zipchat drives sales.
3. **Chat-to-Sale Conversion Rate**\
   This percentage shows how many chats turn into purchases. A higher rate means your chatbot is doing its job: converting conversations into sales.
4. **Average Order Value (AOV)**\
   Discover the average spend of customers who chat with Zipchat. A high AOV? That means your chatbot is not just selling—it’s upselling and cross-selling too.
5. **Chats Started**\
   This metric counts how many times visitors engage with Zipchat. It tells you how often customers find the chatbot useful or appealing.
6. **Total Replies sent by Zipchat**\
   See the total number of messages sent by your chatbot. This helps you gauge its activity level and how much it’s handling for you.

***

### Customer Feedback Metrics

<figure><img src="/files/5SexKtLQquqGvKxO3oHz" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

7. **Great Replies**\
   The number of replies customers loved. It’s a sign your chatbot is providing helpful and satisfying answers.
8. **Good Replies**\
   Replies that didn’t receive ratings—neutral but successful interactions.
9. **Bad Replies**\
   Tracks responses rated negatively by customers. Use this to spot improvement areas for your chatbot.

***

### Engagement Insights

10. **Customers mostly start chats from these pages**\
    Find out where on your site most chats begin. This highlights key pages that drive engagement, like product pages or checkout.

***

#### Why the Dashboard Matters

The dashboard isn’t just numbers—it’s a tool for action. Use it to:

* **Track performance**: See how much Zipchat is boosting your sales and engagement.
* **Identify opportunities**: Spot the top-performing pages or areas where your chatbot can improve.
* **Optimize customer experience**: Use feedback to refine your chatbot’s responses and increase customer satisfaction.

With real-time data and easy-to-understand insights, the Zipchat dashboard helps you stay in control, make smarter decisions, and maximize your chatbot’s potential. It’s your shortcut to more sales, happier customers, and a stronger business. 🚀


# Conversations

The **Conversations** section in Zipchat AI is where you track, analyze, and improve every interaction your chatbot has with customers. Think of it as your toolkit for delivering better experiences, boosting sales, and making sure your chatbot performs at its best.

***

### What You Can Do in the Conversations Section

<figure><img src="/files/THxKi7Of1wjQby6qJvi5" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

1. **Monitor Chats Live**\
   Watch conversations as they happen. See how your chatbot handles customer questions and jump in if needed to guide the chat or provide extra support.
2. **Track Chat-to-Sale Conversions** *(Shopify Only)*\
   Find out exactly which chats led to sales. See how much revenue your chatbot is driving and identify the conversations that seal the deal.
3. **Know Where Chats Start**\
   Every chat is tagged with the page it started from—whether it’s a product page, checkout, or FAQ. This gives you valuable context about the customer’s intent and helps you refine your website or chatbot for better engagement.
4. **Rate and Refine Responses**\
   Customers can rate replies as "good" or "bad." Use this feedback to spot what’s working and what needs improvement. It’s a direct way to understand how well your chatbot is meeting customer needs.
5. **Make Real-Time Corrections**\
   Noticed an answer that’s off? Correct it right away. This feature lets you train the AI on the fly, helping your chatbot learn from mistakes and improve over time. The result? Smarter, more accurate replies that align with your brand’s voice.

***

#### Why It’s Important

The Conversations section isn’t just about tracking chats—it’s about creating better customer experiences and driving results. Here’s how:

* **Improve Customer Satisfaction**: Monitor and tweak chats to ensure visitors feel heard and supported.
* **Boost Sales**: Understand what’s working in sales-focused conversations and replicate it with corrections.
* **Optimize Performance**: Use feedback and corrections to make your chatbot smarter and more reliable every day.

***

#### Make Every Interaction Count

With real-time monitoring, feedback tools, and the ability to fix and refine responses, the Conversations section puts you in control of your chatbot’s performance. It’s your go-to resource for ensuring your AI isn’t just chatting—it’s solving problems, closing sales, and leaving customers happy. 🚀


# Taking Over Chats

In case you feel like you need to take over a chat, both from the Web Chat and WhatsApp campaigns you can easily do it from the Conversation tab.

You select the chat you want to take over and you click on the top right corner button "Take Over".

<figure><img src="/files/U24sHkirfBR4MRlua8Ej" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

It will allow you to send messages to your customers (both on Web and WhatsApp).

<figure><img src="/files/j4vmxKvrIPm1iSv4zoLr" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

As soon as you want the AI to take over again, you just click on "Enable AI Replies".

<figure><img src="/files/ZRYrUJsx2WOmUTYWXTnj" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>


# Contacts

Zipchat Contacts are leads or customer details collected through conversations initiated on your chat widget. These contacts are categorized into **Emails** and **Phone Numbers**, depending on the data collected during the interaction. Here's a detailed overview:

* **Emails:** Customers who provide their email addresses during chat interactions.
* **Phone Numbers:** Customers who have messaged the Whatsapp number connected to your Zipchat account or you have uploaded (coming soon).

You can access these details directly from the **Contacts** section in the dashboard.


# Emails

The **Emails tab** in the **Contacts** section in Zipchat AI helps you see the collected email addresses from visitors who engage with your chatbot. These leads can fuel your marketing campaigns, giving you a direct line to customers who’ve already shown interest in your products or services.&#x20;

<figure><img src="/files/ogKcYjtTlJgkxPcFXB5x" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

### Key Features

1. **Effortless Email Collection**\
   Prompt visitors to share their email addresses during chats. Build a growing list of leads from people who are already engaged with your brand.
2. **Export Leads Easily**\
   Download all collected emails into a CSV file, ready to import into your CRM, email marketing platform, or other tools.
3. **Zapier Integration**\
   Seamlessly connect Zipchat to over 2,000 apps via Zapier. For instance, automatically send leads to tools like Klaviyo or your CRM, so they’re instantly ready for follow-ups and campaigns.
4. **On/Off Toggle for Lead Collection**\
   Choose whether to collect emails or focus solely on conversation. Turn the feature on when you want to grow your email list or off for a more casual interaction.
5. **Leads Overview**\
   See all the email addresses collected, along with visitors who skipped entering their emails. Use this to refine your approach and improve your lead collection strategy.
6. **Track Abandoned Chats**\
   Get insights into visitors who didn’t finish the chat. Use this information to tweak how you request emails and reduce drop-offs.

To set it up correctly, go to the [Bubble Chat: Edit design](/installation-and-setup/chat-settings/channels/bubble-chat-edit-design).

***

### Why It Matters

Collecting emails isn’t just about growing your list—it’s about building meaningful connections with customers. With the Leads section, you can:

* **Boost Engagement**: Keep the conversation going after visitors leave your site.
* **Automate Follow-Ups**: Send leads directly into your sales and marketing tools.
* **Respect Privacy**: Let customers choose whether to share their email or receive marketing communications.

<figure><img src="/files/PbY9gVjRpXGgM96TXSiG" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

### Build Smarter, More Effective Email Lists

The Leads section in Zipchat AI helps you gather high-quality leads effortlessly, while tools like Zapier ensure they’re instantly actionable. By customizing the process and respecting customer preferences, you can create a seamless experience that turns engaged visitors into loyal customers. 🚀


# Phone Numbers

The **Phone Numbers** tab displays all the leads who have engaged with the WhatsApp number connected to Zipchat. It includes details like the phone number, marketing preferences, the number of conversations, and the creation and last conversation dates.&#x20;

You can use the collected phone numbers to send targeted WhatsApp marketing campaigns, allowing for personalized communication and enhanced engagement with your audience. Additionally, you can download the data as a CSV file for further analysis or use in marketing tools.

<figure><img src="/files/ogKcYjtTlJgkxPcFXB5x" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>


# Segments

Segments are group of phone numbers you can upload to run WhatsApp Marketing Campaigns.

<figure><img src="/files/vuBDqaOGOe6tGZydA4sI" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

For example:

* All your customers
* All your cart abandon
* Customer who bought a specific product
* People who attended an online/offline event
* People who are considered VIP
* Any kind of group you wish

You will be able to use these segments for AI WhatsApp Marketing campaigns from [WhatsApp Marketing](/installation-and-setup/campaigns/whatsapp-marketing).


# Campaigns

The **Campaigns** tab allows you to manage and launch two types of campaigns to engage with your audience effectively:

<figure><img src="/files/0ClJyYnHlgEK6bhKPPpj" alt="WhatsApp marketing and proactive chat campaigns inside Zipchat AI"><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

**1. In-Site Proactive Chat**

This feature enables you to send proactive messages to website visitors based on specific rules, such as time spent on a page or specific user actions.

* You can prioritize campaigns by assigning them a ranking (e.g., Pricing Chat has a higher priority than Default).
* Options include previewing, editing, or deleting campaigns.
* Proactive chat helps you capture leads and guide users towards conversion by initiating timely and relevant interactions.

**2. WhatsApp Marketing**

The WhatsApp Marketing section enables you to send personalized messages directly to your collected phone number leads.

* Campaigns can be categorized as **One-off** (single occurrence) or Ongoing (coming soon).
* You can view the status of each campaign, such as:
  * **Ready to send:** Campaign is set up and awaiting dispatch.
  * **Sent:** Campaign has already been delivered.

Both campaign types can be created and managed from this tab to ensure seamless customer communication and improved engagement. Use the "Create Campaign" button to set up new proactive chats or WhatsApp marketing messages.


# Proactive Chat

Proactive Chat in Zipchat AI is like having a savvy assistant on your website, always ready to strike up the right conversation at the right moment. With custom pop-up messages tailored to specific pages or products, it’s a powerful tool to grab attention and guide visitors toward action.

<figure><img src="/files/wFbZwiBQ1A1zQopjwhAx" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

***

### What Makes Proactive Chat Special

1. **Tailored Messaging**\
   Create custom messages for different parts of your website. For example:
   * A friendly “Welcome!” on your homepage.
   * Specific prompts on product pages, like *"Have questions about {{product\_title}}? Let us help!"*
   * Attention-grabbing offers like *"Use COUPON10 for 10% off your first purchase!"*
2. **Priority Settings**\
   Decide which messages take priority. For instance, show a product-specific prompt over a generic message to make the experience more relevant for your visitors.
3. **Dynamic Engagement**\
   When visitors click on the pop-up, it opens the chat window with a pre-set follow-up message. This could offer more details about a product, share a discount code, or highlight a glowing customer review.

***

### Examples of Proactive Chat in Action

<figure><img src="/files/o4Ql8L429D4GXWKf7xjT" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

* **On a Product Page**:\
  \&#xNAN;*"Need help deciding on {{product\_title}}? Ask away!"*
* **On a Landing Page**:\
  \&#xNAN;*"Hi! I'm here to answer any questions about our new collection."*
* **For Promotions**:\
  \&#xNAN;*"Grab your 15% OFF with code WELCOME15!"*
* **For Special Offers**:\
  \&#xNAN;*"Looking for deals? Click here to save!"*

***

### Why Proactive Chat Works

* **Drives Conversions**: Engaging visitors at key moments increases the chance they’ll take action, like making a purchase or asking for more info.
* **Personalized Experience**: Tailored messages make visitors feel like the site understands their needs.
* **Easy Setup**: No advanced skills required—just a few clicks, and your chatbot becomes a proactive sales assistant.

The Advanced Setup feature in Zipchat AI lets you fine-tune your Proactive Chat messages to engage visitors exactly where, when, and how you want. With this powerful customization, you can deliver relevant, well-timed interactions that grab attention and drive conversions.

***

### How It Works

**Target Your Audience**

<figure><img src="/files/30b7NPWhtcqq42TWw1Zy" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

Decide exactly where your Proactive Chat messages appear:

* **All Pages**: Make the message visible across your entire website.
* **Specific Pages**: Target particular URLs, like a landing page or checkout.
* **All Product Pages**: Reach visitors exploring your catalog.
* **Specific Product Pages**: Highlight deals or assistance for individual items.

**NOTE:** You can exclude Pages: Keep messages off non-relevant areas like the contact page or FAQ.

***

### **Time Your Message**

Engage visitors at the perfect moment with two flexible triggers:

1. **Time-Based Trigger**\
   Set a timer to display the message after visitors have been on the page for a specific duration.\
   Example: *Show the message 5 seconds after they land.*
2. **Scroll-Based Trigger**\
   Trigger the message based on how far a visitor has scrolled down the page.\
   Example: *Display the message when they’ve scrolled 50% of the page.*

<figure><img src="/files/7MLZEm1OPUQO114gAGmw" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

***

### **Craft the Perfect Message**

Zipchat offers two types of messages to engage visitors seamlessly:

1. **Pop-Up Message**\
   A small, attention-grabbing message appears just above the chat bubble.\
   Example: *"Hi, is there anything I can help you with?"*
2. **Follow-Up Conversation Message**\
   When visitors click the popup, this message appears in the chat.\
   Example: *"Hello! Let me know how I can help. You can ask me anything you want."*

<figure><img src="/files/l1Lk5UyRfgQ9sZPJCDVQ" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

***

### **Preview and Activate**

* **Preview Your Message**: See how the popup and follow-up look before launching to ensure everything aligns with your goals and brand.
* **Activate the Message**: Once you're satisfied, turn it on. The message will appear based on the conditions you’ve set.

<figure><img src="/files/JRzLssA2ZHzhUng1Wog9" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

***

### Example Setup

* **Name (Visible to You)**: *“Product Page Promo”*
* **Target Audience**: Specific product pages featuring top-selling items.
* **Trigger**: After 10 seconds or 50% scroll on the page.
* **Pop-Up Message**: *“Need help deciding on {{product\_title}}? Click here to ask!”*
* **Conversation Message**: *“Hi! I’m here to help you with {{product\_title}}. Feel free to ask any questions or let me know how I can assist!”*

***

### Make Proactive Chat Your Secret Weapon

Zipchat AI’s Proactive Chat helps you turn passive visitors into engaged customers by starting the right conversations. Whether it’s answering product questions, promoting offers, or simply saying “Hi,” this feature makes your chatbot smarter, more engaging, and better at boosting your sales.&#x20;

## Step 5: What you can do with WhatsApp Marketing

Add a new high performing marketing channel, on auto-pilot:

👉 **Email:** 15-25% Open Rate, avg. $20+ return per $1 spent 👉 **SMS:** 80-90% Open Rate, avg. $10+ return per $1 spent 😍 **WhatsApp Marketing:** 90%+ Open Rate, avg. $25+ return per $1 spent

😈 AI **WhatsApp Marketing:** 95%+ Open Rate, avg. $40+ return per $1 spent

### How does AI WhatsApp change the game forever? Welcome to conversational marketing on steroids.

<figure><img src="/files/7zAScC6wwnubc3CgfaNL" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

<figure><img src="/files/LWZ3h52VHLuuufMDLm7n" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

Basically AI WhatsApp Marketing allows you to send broadcast messages that feel natural and 1to1 human written.

This level of “cozyness” stimulate high open rates and incredible reply rates, something that doesn’t happen with traditional WhatsApp, Email and SMS campaigns.

By replying, users start a conversation with you.

This conversation is entirely manage by the AI, following your campaign prompt (you have a 10,000 characters prompt for each campaign you send out). Possibilities are endless and limited only by your marketing creativity.

***

## Step 6: Define an Audience

In this step you have to think about what segment of users to target.

The right way to think here, is to understand what’s the Goal of this first campaign.

* Generate sales?
* Get reviews?
* Whatever a conversation on WhatsApp can lead to for you…

Think about what audience would resonate most with your campaign goal. If your objective is **generating sales**, focus on segments like:

* **Past Buyers:** Customers who bought from you before but haven’t returned recently.
* **Abandoned Cart Users:** People who added T-Shirts to their cart but didn’t check out.
* **Engaged Customers:** Users who frequently interact with your website or WhatsApp messages.

If your goal is to **gather reviews**, consider targeting:

* **Recent Purchasers:** Customers who received their orders and may have positive feedback.
* **Loyal Customers:** Those who’ve bought multiple times and are likely advocates for your brand.

***(You can upload your segment lists from*** [Segments](/installation-and-setup/contacts/segments)***.)***

For example. Let’s say you are a cosmetics Brand. We are in May, and you have 1,000 people who bought the anti-cellulite cream in April. As a general assumption, you can consider that these 1,000 people suffer from cellulite problem and that during summer they will want to fight it as much as they can.

You can then prepare a “summer bundle”, a box with 3-anti cellulite creams + some other complimentary product.

Instead of selling each cream at $59, you can bundle it at $119.

**🎯 Campaign goal:** convert previous buyers into repeat buyers promoting a $119 bundle.

👥  **Audience:** 1,000 people who bought an anti-cellulite cream in April.

***

## Step 7: Think about your Prompt

Now that you have though about your audience, selected the segment (list of numbers) and thought about the promotion you want to drive traffic to, you need to setup the campaign.

**Note: during this Beta phase just share the list with the team. Later, you will be able to upload it directly through your account.**

Go to the “Campaigns” section and click on create campaigns.

### **1. Accessing the Campaign Creation Menu**

1. Navigate to the **Campaigns** tab in the Zipchat dashboard.
2. Click the **Create Campaign** button.
3. In the pop-up window, select **WhatsApp Campaign** and click **Create**.

<figure><img src="/files/SfEg2E1ExygTTWdKP7Yg" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

Choose a name for the campaign.

Choose a segment for the campaign ( [Segments](/installation-and-setup/contacts/segments)).

Choose an “opening message”. Since as per the example at Step 6 we are selling an anti-cellulite bundle + bonus to people who bought an anti-cellulite cream during the previous month, we can create a first message like:

> Hi 👋, it’s Marina from \[BRAND NAME]. I just wanted to checking in and see how the anti-cellulite cream you bought from us last month is doing on you? Are you happy with it?
>
> By the way, planning any beach vacation soon? I’m going to Mallorca mid-July.

The above message doesn’t feel spammy, it builds a trust and a relationship and it’s a good hook to start talking.

You can write an “unsubscribe instruction”, for example:

<figure><img src="/files/Ux7QL9zJAr8GY3AakMw0" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

At this point you need to write the campaign prompt. With experience and time you will do this in a couple minutes, or you will have your ready to go templates.

<figure><img src="/files/FrxGY9DtJqvMpCW5Uxcp" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

Personally, I’d prompt the campaign that way:

> You are Marina from \[BRAND NAME]. You're gentle and use cool emojis professionally and empathetically to create an engaging and friendly experience for the customer you are talking to.
>
> You are a beauty consultant and you really care about your client being beautiful and feeling great.
>
> Your goal is to sell the anti-cellulite bundle which include:
>
> * 3 anti-cellulite creams, valued at $59 each ($177 total value)
> * 1 bonus cream, valued at $39
> * Total bundle value of: $216
>
> For a staggering: $119 promotion, valid only for 24 hours. The promotion is available at this link: [www.brand.com/bundle](http://www.brand.com/bundle)
>
> Starting Message we send first (just to give you context): ”Hi 👋, it’s Marina from \[BRAND NAME]. I just wanted to checking in and see how the anti-cellulite cream you bought from us last month is doing on you? Are you happy with it?
>
> By the way, planning any beach vacation soon? I’m going to Mallorca mid-July.”
>
> Scenario 1: They haven’t used it yet, or just started Your goal here is to understand why with emphatic questions. Then, you can keep following the conversation understanding their goals with the cream and if they are traveling somewhere. As soon as the conversation is “hot” to promote the bundle, explain you have an offer going on, explain and link the bundle, explaining that it has been created to provide a summer long stock of product so the results can be visible and consistent.
>
> Scenario 2: They are using it, they like it That’s the best scenario. You can ask about whether they are using it for a general goal or if they have a specific vacation they want to “look” perfect for. As soon as the conversation is “hot” to promote the bundle, explain you have an offer going on, explain and link the bundle, explaining that it has been created to provide a summer long stock of product so the results can be visible and consistent.
>
> Scenario 3: They are using it, they don’t like it Try to understand why they don’t like it by asking questions, waiting for a reply and then asking more questions. You might find out the reason rely in results not being immediate. Explain, empathically, that results take some time and recommend to use the product with consistency. Ask about their goal and whether they need to get to a certain results by a certain date, maybe for a vacation. As soon as the conversation is “hot” to promote the bundle, explain you have an offer going on, explain and link the bundle, explaining that it has been created to provide a summer long stock of product so the results can be visible and consistent.
>
> \[Scenario X: You can add as many ideas as you can come up with]
>
> Key Notes:
>
> * Always ask relevant and emphatic questions, you must make the prospect feeling like she is talking to a real human, not an AI.
> * Keep the tone warm and professional with a touch of dopamine-boosting emojis.
> * Tailor responses to align with the prospect's expressed interest and goal, while gently pushing toward the bundle.
> * If the prospect is not interested, thank them for their time and say you're there if they need help with anything related with beauty, that as a beauty consultant it will be your pleasure to help.
> * If customer responds with STOP, tell them you'll remove them from the list.

For reference: the above prompt is only “3,230 characters”. The limit is 10,000. You can add much more context and play with it.

***

## Step 8: Draft the Campaign

As soon are you are ready, just click on “Save Draft” in the bottom right corner.

<figure><img src="/files/1nsI5gDPJEb6fuNaOmyy" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

## Step 9: Test & Send the Campaign

<figure><img src="/files/1FfXVdK7qecNWTlg8NVf" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

* From this page you an:
  * **Delete:** Delete the campaign.
  * **Edit Campaign:** Edit the settings of the campaign.
  * **Test:** Test the conversation and understand whether you should update/change the prompt.

Meanwhile, by clicking on the top-right button, “test”, you can open the internal simulator and play with the chat to see whether your prompt is well structured.

<figure><img src="/files/p3hwO2xyRZw4EQJ4eh9s" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

Once the campaign is approved by Meta (usually a few minutes, sometimes up to 60’), you will see the “ready to send tag” next to the title.

<figure><img src="/files/nbW1Ype51M7ohoHF6fIc" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

Just click the “send campaign” on the top right and the campaign will be sent.

***

## Step 10: Meta Costs

All interactions initiated through the WhatsApp campaign, including customer replies, will be displayed in the **Conversations** tab. This allows you to monitor and manage ongoing chats effectively, taking them over if necessary, ensuring a seamless customer engagement process.

By leveraging the AI WhatsApp Campaign feature, you can maintain personalized communication and build stronger relationships with your audience.


# AI Training

The **AI Training** feature in Zipchat helps you refine your chatbot's performance, ensuring it gets better at understanding and responding to customer queries. By tailoring the AI to align with your brand’s tone, products, and industry knowledge, you can create a chatbot that feels like a natural extension of your team.

<figure><img src="/files/xm2FvuBHNmBhYV065uUK" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

### Key Features

1. **Train with Additional Context**\
   Provide resources like:
   * **PDFs**: Upload product guides, FAQs, or manuals.
   * **Links**: Add website pages or external articles.
   * **👉** [**More details here**](/installation-and-setup/ai-training/knowledge-base)&#x20;
2. **Correct Inaccurate Responses**\
   If the AI gives an off-the-mark reply, you can step in and correct it. These corrections help the chatbot learn and improve over time, making future interactions more accurate and helpful.
3. **Feedback Loop**\
   Every interaction contributes to a feedback system. Monitor customer ratings on AI responses ("good" or "bad") and use this input to fine-tune its performance.
4. **Brand Alignment**\
   Customize responses to match your brand’s tone and language. Whether your style is casual and friendly or professional and precise, you can shape the chatbot to speak just like your team.

***

### Why AI Training Matters

* **Better Customer Experience**: Tailored responses build trust and show customers you understand their needs.
* **Increased Accuracy**: As the AI learns from corrections and added context, it can handle more complex questions confidently.
* **Consistency**: Ensure every customer interaction reflects your brand’s values and messaging.

***

### How It Works

1. **Upload Resources**\
   Add key documents or links to train the AI on specific topics.
2. **Review Chat History**\
   Look at past interactions to identify responses that need improvement.
3. **Make Corrections**\
   Adjust the AI’s reply to align with your standards. For example, correct product details or refine explanations.
4. **Monitor Progress**\
   Track how well the AI performs over time using feedback and chat success metrics.


# Knowledge Base

The **Knowledge Base** is where Zipchat AI gets the information it uses to answer customer questions. It starts by automatically crawling your website to gather key details like product descriptions, FAQs, and other content. You’ll see all your website URLs already listed in this section. But you can do so much more to make the AI smarter and more effective.

<figure><img src="/files/zdxl8lrBMnKX1mKbufxv" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

***

### How to Expand and Update Your Knowledge Base

1. **Automatic Crawling**
   * Zipchat scans all your site pages and adds them to the Knowledge Base.
   * It pulls details like product info and policies directly from your site, ensuring the chatbot stays up to date.
2. **Add Extra Information**\
   Boost the AI’s ability to handle complex questions by manually adding these formats:
   * **Single Page**: Paste a URL for an updated page, subdomain, or external site. The AI will crawl it immediately.
   * **Multiple Pages**: Provide the main URL, and Zipchat will scan all linked pages. Perfect for capturing related content in one go.
   * **PDF Uploads**: Upload guides, charts, or manuals to give the AI detailed, searchable information. Example: A sizing guide or warranty details.
   * **Blank Text**: Add specific content directly into the Knowledge Base. Only the text is indexed, so make it concise and relevant.
   * **CSV with Links**: Can’t crawl certain pages? Upload a list of URLs in CSV format to include them manually.
   * **Sitemap (XML)**: Upload your XML sitemap for efficient and comprehensive crawling of your entire site structure.

***

### Why It Matters

* **Enhanced Accuracy**: By adding and updating content, the chatbot provides precise answers to even the most detailed customer inquiries.
* **Better Engagement**: A well-rounded Knowledge Base helps your chatbot engage visitors with confidence, whether it’s recommending a product or answering a tricky question.
* **Always Up-to-Date**: Regular updates ensure the AI reflects your latest offerings, promotions, or policy changes.

***

### How to Make the Most of It

1. **Add Specific Pages**\
   Include newly updated product pages, promotional pages, or subdomains not automatically captured.
2. **Upload Supporting Documents**\
   PDFs like product manuals, comparison charts, or step-by-step guides help the AI handle specific or technical questions.
3. **Use Blank Text for FAQs**\
   Quickly add answers to new FAQs or specific instructions for seasonal campaigns.
4. **Regularly Update**\
   Keep your knowledge base fresh by revisiting it after website changes or new launches.

***

### Deliver Smarter, Faster Support

A robust Knowledge Base transforms Zipchat AI into a highly effective assistant that not only answers questions but also resolves issues with precision. By combining automatic website crawling with custom additions like PDFs and URLs, you can ensure your chatbot is equipped to provide an exceptional customer experience—every time. 🚀


# Chat Corrections

<figure><img src="/files/k5BdaKIpzWeoD5bYBuSg" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

Corrections give you the opportunity to provide additional training to your AI agent regarding specific questions that are not answered in your knowledge base.

***

### How corrections work

Corrections work by building additional Q\&A entries on top of what you already have on your website knowledge.

Whenever you create a correction, a new entry is added to the knowledge base in a Question and Answer format, for example

> *Q: Do you ship to Australia*\
> *A: Yes, we ship to Australia via DHL in 3-5 days*

The next time someone asks something about shipping to Australia, Zipchat will see the Q\&A you just created.

### When to use corrections

Corrections should be used when you're adding missing information to the knowledge base. They work great to improve a response that relies on the knowledge of the AI agent ( instead of its behaviour or actions )

### When corrections don't work

There are two major limitations of corrections

#### Trying to modify the AI agent's behaviour

Corrections are only loaded when Zipchat does an "information search", but don't work for other AI tools like "Order tracking", "Escalate conversation", etc..

If you're trying to teach Zipchat how they should behave when someone asks for their order information ( for example ), that won't work - Zipchat won't even look for information.

Instead, you should modify the additional instructions of the AI agent from AI training / Prompt & Tools

As a rule of thumb:

* Use corrections when you want to change what Zipchat knows
* Use prompting/instructions when you want to change what Zipchat does

#### Conflicting information

You may create a correction, but if there's conflicting information on your website ( or in another correction ), the AI agent might be confused&#x20;

If you're making corrections but not getting an improved response, it's a good idea to check

* Your existing corrections -> are there other corrections that say the opposite?
* Check if some of your web pages have outdated info

***

### Why Chat Corrections Matter

1. **Smarter Over Time**\
   Every correction you make teaches the AI something new. Over time, these adjustments create a feedback loop, making your chatbot more accurate and aligned with your business goals.
2. **Tailored to Your Business**\
   No two businesses are the same, and generic responses don’t always work. Chat Corrections let you tweak answers to match your tone, provide detailed information, or fix inaccuracies—making the chatbot feel like a true extension of your team.
3. **Better Customer Experience**\
   By refining responses, your customers get the most accurate and helpful information. This leads to happier customers, more conversions, and repeat business.
4. **Quick and Easy Adjustments**\
   No waiting for tech updates or support help. You can make changes in real-time, saving time and staying agile as your business evolves.

***

### How to Use Chat Corrections

<figure><img src="/files/BmLmg7iERhV1e7mZklE2" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

1. **Monitor Chats Regularly**\
   Review conversations to spot any inaccurate or off-brand responses. You can do it from [Conversations](/installation-and-setup/conversations).
2. **Provide Instant Feedback**\
   When you find a mistake or want to improve a reply, correct it directly. Update the content or language to better fit your needs.
3. **Set Expiry Dates** *(Optional)*\
   For time-sensitive corrections, like promotions or out-of-stock updates, you can set an expiry date. The AI will "forget" the correction once it’s no longer relevant.
4. **Manage All Corrections**\
   From the corrections section, view all your adjustments. Edit, delete, or set/remove expiry dates easily to keep everything up to date.

***

### Take Charge of Your Chatbot

With Chat Corrections, you can make your Zipchat AI smarter, faster, and better every day. Fine-tune its responses to match your brand, enhance customer interactions, and deliver a truly superior experience—all with a tool that’s simple to use and incredibly powerful. 🚀


# Prompt & tools

Page location: AI Training / Prompt & Tools

<figure><img src="/files/aH0CAhd0TGkfqn2rBuH2" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

Zipchat allows you to fully control how your AI behaves by combining global prompts, additional instructions, and tool-specific prompting.

This layered approach lets you fine-tune tone, goals, escalation behavior, and how actions are performed.

This page explains how each part works and how they interact.

***

### Overview: How Zipchat AI Is Configured

Zipchat AI behavior is defined through four main layers:

1. Core Prompt – global personality, tone, and rules
2. Contact Info – what to do when human support is needed
3. Additional Instructions – sales flows, positioning, and advanced logic
4. Tools & Tool-Specific Instructions – how and when actions are performed

Each layer builds on top of the previous one.

***

### Core Prompt (Base Behavior)

The Core Prompt defines Zipchat’s overall behavior and applies to all Zipchat bots. This is the base behaviour of a good e-commerce agent and and it handles most things out of the box.

***

### Contact Info

The Contact Info field defines what Zipchat should do when a customer wants to talk to a human.

Zipchat uses this information when:

* A visitor explicitly asks for human support
* A conversation is escalated via the Escalation tool

This typically includes:

* A support email address
* Instructions on how to proceed if live help is required

Inside it, you can write down instructions on how to be contacted in free-form text.

***

### Additional Instructions (Behavior & Sales Logic)

Additional Instructions are layered on top of the Core Prompt and are ideal for defining how Zipchat should operate in practice.

Use this section to:

* Set tone of voice ( use of emojies, specific words, etc )
* Define pre-sales questions
* Tell Zipchat how to handle sepcific cases

#### Example use cases

* "Before suggestinng a product, ask X, Y & Z"
* "Be cringey and sneak as many dad jokes as possible when replying"
* "Whenever a customer asks about X, do Y"

> Think of Additional Instructions as your business playbook

***

### Tools & Tool-Specific Prompting

Zipchat can perform actions using Tools (for example: Knowledge Search, Escalation, Order Lookup, etc.).

Each tool can be:

* Enabled or disabled
* Activated per channel
* Configured with its own prompting

#### Tool Core Prompt

Every tool has a Tool Core Prompt that defines:

* When the tool should be used
* The basic conditions for triggering it

#### Tool Additional Instructions

Each tool also supports Additional Instructions, allowing you to customize:

* How the AI explains the action to the customer
* Extra guardrails or conditions
* Tool-specific behavior without affecting other tools

<br>

#### Why this matters

Tool instructions allow fine-grained control.

Examples:

* Ask clarifying questions before escalating to human support
* Escalate only if the user is asking about this topic
* Create discounts if the customer says the product is too expensive

***

### List of available tools

* Knowledge Search
* [Escalate conversation ( Forward request ) ](/installation-and-setup/ai-training/prompt-and-tools/forward-request)
* [Order lookup](/installation-and-setup/ai-training/prompt-and-tools/order-tracking)
* Create discounts ( Shopify only )&#x20;
* Skip Conversation

***

### Best Practices

* Keep Core Prompts clear and high-level
* Use Additional Instructions for business logic
* Use Tool Instructions for precise control
* Avoid overly long prompts—clarity beats verbosity
* Test changes using Test Chat after updates


# Order Tracking

<figure><img src="/files/i0UKcxpewGLJM20WiUFv" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

The **Order Tracking** feature streamlines customer inquiries by providing real-time updates on order statuses.

* **Shopify Integration**: Instantly retrieves order details using the customer’s email and order number directly from your Shopify store.
* **Seamless Experience**: Customers get accurate updates without leaving the chat, enhancing convenience and satisfaction.
* **Support Automation**: Handles tracking inquiries automatically, saving your support team time while keeping customers informed.

This tool ensures a smooth, hassle-free experience, boosting customer satisfaction and loyalty. 🚀


# Shopify: Write custom shipping notes

### Why you should set up the `additional_shipping_information` metafield

When you use Zipchat, one of its key features is: it **automatically** checks an order’s shipping status in Shopify and communicates to the customer what’s happening.

\
But sometimes an order isn’t shipped yet **and** Shopify there's no status update. In these cases, without any extra information the customer is left in the dark.

\
By adding a custom metafield like `custom.additional_shipping_information`, you can proactively add a human-readable note (for example: “Shipment delayed because of X, expected to ship on Y”), and Zipchat can detect it and show it to the customer instead of showing “no update.”<br>

In short:

* This provides better transparency and customer experience.
* It reduces support tickets (“Where is my order?”) because you’re telling customers the reason and expected timeline.
* It enables Zipchat to function more intelligently — fallback from “no shipping status” into “custom note exists → show that note.”

***

### How to set up the `additional_shipping_information` metafield in Shopify, for use by Zipchat

#### 1. Create the metafield definition

1. In your Shopify Admin go to **Settings → Custom data (or Metafields & Metaobjects)**.&#x20;
2. Select the resource you want this metafield to apply to — in this case: **Orders** (since you want the note attached to an order).
3. Click **Add definition** (to create a new custom metafield) because you’re storing data that isn’t captured by Shopify by default.&#x20;
4. Fill in the fields:
   * **Name**:  `Additional Shipping Information` - *if you pick a different name, make sure you update the key to be correct*
   * **Namespace and key**: Set namespace = `custom`  and key = `additional_shipping_information`. When combined this results in `custom.additional_shipping_information`. **This is important** because your Zipchat integration will look precisely for this key.
   * **Content type**: Type: One >  *Multi-line text field*&#x20;
   * Optionally: add a description like “Enter shipping-delay or shipping-note for Zipchat to display to customer when order hasn’t shipped yet.”
5. Save the definition.

#### 2. Populate the metafield value for a given order

1. Go to your Shopify Admin → Orders → open the specific order that **has not yet shipped** (or you anticipate a delay).
2. Within that order record, scroll down till you find the **Metafields** section (sometimes you might need to expand “Show more” or scroll to bottom).
3. Locate the metafield you just defined: `custom.additional_shipping_information`.
4. Enter the shipping-note value, e.g.:

   > “Shipment delayed because of X; the order is expected to ship on Y.”
5. Save the order.

#### 3. Zipchat reads the metafield and performs its logic

* When Zipchat queries Shopify for the order status, if it detects that `custom.additional_shipping_information` has a value, Zipchat will present that value to the customer (e.g., “Your order is delayed: Shipment delayed because of X; expected on Y”).
* If there is no value in that metafield, Zipchat will fall back to the normal status-update route (or maybe say “no update yet”).<br>

***

### Quick reference table for merchants

| Item                  | Value/Setting                                                                  |
| --------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Definition name       | `additional_shipping_information`.                                             |
| Namespace + key       | `custom.additional_shipping_information`                                       |
| Resource (applies to) | Order                                                                          |
| Content type          | Multi-line text (or single line if simpler)                                    |
| Purpose               | Enter shipping delay note or expected ship date when no shipping update exists |
| Outcome               | Zipchat shows the note to the customer as fallback when no shipped status      |

***

### Connect your ERP or custom apps

Because the metafield is created by you, this allows other apps to also write inside of it. This can be useful if you want to automatically add shipping notes like "expected shipment", etc


# Forward Request

Escalation ensures your customers always receive the right level of support, even when the AI cannot fully resolve a request. When a visitor asks for human assistance or the AI detects a complex issue, the conversation is forwarded to your support team. This prevents frustration, improves customer experience, and allows you to automatically create support tickets in platforms like Zendesk for proper tracking and follow up.

<figure><img src="/files/cPo9VB9azW6uwechXwlp" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

**To configure this feature:**

1. Go to your **Zipchat Dashboard** and navigate to **AI Training**.
2. Open the **Prompt and Tools** sub-tab, scroll down to the **Tools** section, and activate **Escalate Conversations**.
3. Once activated, choose how you want to receive escalation notifications:
   * **In-app only**: You will see escalated conversations inside the **Conversations** tab, marked with a red diamond and red exclamation point.
   * **In-app + Email notifications**: Toggle this option on and specify the email address where escalated conversations should be sent.
4. If you are using Zendesk, enter the same email address connected to your Zendesk account. Escalated chats will then be forwarded to that inbox and appear as regular tickets inside Zendesk.
5. Use the **Additional Instructions** section to define special escalation behavior. For example, you can instruct the AI to escalate conversations when certain topics are mentioned, or to avoid answering specific subjects and instead forward those chats directly to human support.
6. Save your configuration and test the flow to ensure escalations are delivered through your selected notification method.


# Test your Chatbot

The **Test Your Chatbot** feature in Zipchat AI gives you the tools to evaluate and refine your chatbot’s performance in a controlled environment. By testing its responses to a variety of scenarios, you can ensure your chatbot meets customer expectations, aligns with your brand, and delivers top-notch interactions from day one.

<figure><img src="/files/tHKRedIFsKFgjBf5n9kN" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

### Why Testing Your Chatbot Matters

1. **Fine-Tune Custom Instructions**\
   Test how well your chatbot follows the instructions you’ve set. Does it greet customers the way you want? Does it provide detailed answers or use the right tone? Testing lets you adjust these settings until everything is just right.
2. **Optimize the Knowledge Base**\
   See how effectively the chatbot uses the resources in your Knowledge Base, such as PDFs, links, or text entries. If the AI struggles to retrieve the correct information, it might be time to update or refine your content.
3. **Catch and Fix Errors**\
   Spot inaccuracies, misunderstandings, or gaps in knowledge before the chatbot interacts with real customers. This proactive approach ensures a smoother experience when you go live.
4. **Build Confidence in Your AI**\
   By thoroughly testing your chatbot, you can deploy it with peace of mind, knowing it’s prepared to handle customer queries effectively and enhance your brand’s reputation.

***

### How to Use the Test Your Chatbot Tool

1. **Simulate Customer Queries**\
   Test a wide range of scenarios:
   * Common questions (e.g., “What’s your return policy?”)
   * Complex scenarios (e.g., “How does this product compare to \[another product]?”)
   * Edge cases (e.g., vague or confusing questions)
2. **Review AI Responses**\
   Analyze the chatbot’s replies for:
   * Accuracy: Is the information correct?
   * Relevance: Does the response answer the question?
   * Tone: Does it match your brand’s voice?
3. **Refine and Improve**\
   Based on your observations:
   * Adjust the **Custom Instructions** to improve tone and behavior.
   * Update the **Knowledge Base** with missing or clearer information.
   * Correct replies.
   * Remove irrelevant data that could confuse the AI.
4. **Iterate as Needed**\
   Testing is an ongoing process. Keep refining and testing until the chatbot consistently meets your expectations.

***

### Example Scenarios to Test

* **Customer Welcome**: *“Hi there! How can I help you today?”*
  * Check if the chatbot’s tone feels inviting and helpful.
* **Product Details**: *“Can you tell me more about \[Product Name]?”*
  * Verify if the AI retrieves accurate and detailed information.
* **Policy Inquiries**: *“What’s your return policy?”*
  * Ensure the AI provides a clear and correct explanation.
* **Handling Unknowns**: *“Can you do X?”*
  * Confirm it responds gracefully when it can’t help, such as: *“I’d love to help, but that’s outside my scope. Let me guide you to the right resource.”*

***

### The Benefits of Testing

* **Flawless Interactions**: Spot and resolve issues before they impact your customers.
* **Customer Satisfaction**: A well-tested chatbot delivers accurate, helpful, and professional responses, improving the customer experience.
* **Stronger Brand Presence**: Confidently launch an AI that aligns with your brand’s tone and values.

***

### Launch with Confidence

The **Test Your Chatbot** feature is your safety net, ensuring your chatbot is polished, professional, and ready to impress. With thorough testing, you can deliver a seamless customer experience that drives satisfaction and conversions—right from the start. 🚀

* Provides an iframe code to embed the chat directly into a webpage.
* **Usage:**
  * Embed the chat widget without requiring users to click a chat bubble.

***

This section gives you full control over how Zipchat integrates with your website and external communication channels, ensuring smooth setup and operation for both you and your customers.


# Instagram Channel Prerequisites

In order to have the Instagram channel working on Zipchat, your brand needs:

* a Facebook page
* a Professional Instagram account - **personal Instagram accounts are not supported**
* Facebook page **connected with** the Professional Instagram account

The following message means your agent is missing one of the prerequisites above:

<figure><img src="/files/NMIh61utdq7iquINcl3x" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

### Professional Instagram Account

Your Instagram account must be a professional account (Creator or Business). If your brand is currently using a personal account, no worries - you’ll just need to switch it to a professional profile before enabling the Instagram channel on Zipchat.

See [official Instagram docs](https://help.instagram.com/502981923235522) on how to set up a professional account.

### Connecting your Facebook Page with the Instagram Account

1. Visit <https://business.facebook.com/> on a browser.
2. Ensure you have the proper Business Portfolio selected on the left-hand side menu.
3. Go to "Accounts" -> "Pages" and select the Facebook page of your brand:

<figure><img src="/files/fwXeEwdSck8q1vBSg5tT" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

4. Click "Connect assets" and pick "Instagram account":

<figure><img src="/files/o8hFENmw38Xk82Pb9g1A" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

5. Login with your Professional Instagram account:

<figure><img src="/files/mK4yAwe1ZsoP0bgGkiZP" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

6. Allow access to Instagram messages in inbox:

<figure><img src="/files/OHlPZR2RObCxB46EPTdr" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

7. Click "Done" to finish:

<figure><img src="/files/DokakIwz7jBv1bRsnMM5" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

8. Go back to the "Chat settings" page on Zipchat, click "Confirm setup" and authorize your Facebook page/Instagram account again:

<figure><img src="/files/NMIh61utdq7iquINcl3x" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

9. If everything is all right you should see following status after refreshing the page:

<figure><img src="/files/uaDLBcp4JZGbkkUwgCDF" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

In case you still see "Action required" after refreshing the page it means there is something missing. Go back and review the steps above.


# WhatsApp Agent: Start Guide

## Why WhatsApp

WhatsApp is a service and marketing channel with incredible potential; it’s the most used messaging app in Europe, LATAM, India, and it’s growing fast in the United States

Main reasons to use WA:

* Open rate of marketing messages: 85%
* Click-through-rate: 15%
* Automatic collection of the customer’s Name, Surname and Phone Number
* 24 hours to keep the conversation going, while if someone texts you on your website, as soon as they close the browser you cannot reach to them
* You are always in your customers pocket, one conversation away
* Most importantly - customers EXPECT to speak with you on WA

## Start Guide: Prerequisites

### 1️⃣ Get a phone number

To connect Zipchat & WhatsApp, you need a phone number; you can use an existing phone numbe or buy a new one.

**USING AN EXISTING PHONE NUMBER**

If you decide to use an existing phone number, you need to cancel your existing WhatsApp or WhatsApp Business Account first. If you don’t do it, you won’t be able to complete the integration. [You can cancel your account following this guide.](https://faq.whatsapp.com/2138577903196467/?cms_platform=android)

⚠️ If you cancel your account, you will loose all the existing conversations with your customers. Conversations cannot be transferred from one account to another.

While a lot of customers have no problems in cancelling their existing account, if you don’t want to do so or don’t want to loose all the conversations, you can always buy a new phone number.

**BUYING A NEW PHONE NUMBER**

You can buy any phone number you want, from a virtual or phisical provider. You can also buy a number from [Yourbusinessnumber.com](http://Yourbusinessnumber.com) , a good provider (not associated with Zipchat) that allows you to buy a number in only a couple of minutes.

&#x20;👉🏻 Pro tip: many virtual providers only offer phone numbers with UK or US country code, and that’s actually not a problem. Once your number is connected to Zipchat, you can request Meta to approve your display name and your customers won’t see your phone number but your company name, even if they don’t have you registered as a contact.

### 2️⃣ Facebook Business Verification

To fully use the WhatsApp API via ZipChat, your Facebook Business must be verified. Without verification, access is limited to a 30‑day trial period.

&#x20;⚠️ Facebook Business Verification is different from verifying a Facebook Business Page.

**Steps to Verify Your Business**

1. Log in to your **Facebook Business Manager** (or create one if needed).
2. Go to **Business Settings**.
3. Scroll to **Security Center**.
4. Click **Start Verification** — there are four main steps.
5. Enter your **business information** (e.g. name, address, phone).
6. Facebook may suggest matching businesses — select yours, then click **Next**.
7. Confirm your details.
8. Choose a **verification method** (e.g. document upload or phone).
9. Enter the **verification code** received.
10. Submit and wait for confirmation.

### 3️⃣ Prepare WhatsApp Assets

To offer your customers the best experience, please prepare the following assets:

* A profile image (ideally, your logo) in square format, max 5mb
* A business description (max 256 letters) to add in your profile
* Your company address to add in your profile

### 🎉 Great! You can now integrate WA & Zipchat

Now that you have completed all these steps, you can now integrate WhatsApp & Zipchat.

[**Complete the integration by yourself, following this guide (it takes only 5 minutes 🕑)**](https://www.notion.so/WhatsApp-Setup-of-the-Agent-Marketing-Campaigns-28271caef48b800da72de217662f447f?pvs=21)


# Bubble Chat: Edit design

Zipchat AI gives you complete control over your chatbot’s appearance and interaction style. By aligning the chatbot’s design with your website’s branding and tailoring its functionality, you create a seamless and engaging user experience that encourages customer interaction.

You can edit your bubble chat design by going to Channels / Bubble Chat / Edit

***

#### Key Customization Options

**1. AI Agent Personalization**

* **Name of Your AI Agent**: Set a relatable name and role for your chatbot.\
  Example: *Luca from \[BRAND NAME] | Online.*
* **Avatar**: Upload an avatar or photo to give your chatbot a human touch.\
  \&#xNAN;*Tip*: Use a friendly and approachable image to build trust.

***

**2. Welcome Message**

* Create a warm, inviting first impression with a custom message.\
  Example:\
  \&#xNAN;*"Welcome to \[BRAND NAME] 😎! I'm Luca, how can I help you today?"*

***

**3. Predefined Messages (Chat Starters)**

* Add quick-action buttons to guide users into specific conversations.\
  Examples:
  * *"Product Recommendation"*
  * *"Order Tracking"*
  * *"Gift Ideas"*
* These messages make it easier for customers to engage without typing, improving efficiency and interaction rates.

***

**4. Placeholder Message**

* Set a placeholder in the input field to guide users on what to type.\
  Example: *"Write a message."*

***

**5. Chat Widget Customization**

* **Color**: Choose a widget color that matches your website’s theme.\
  Example: *Hex Code: #000000* (for a sleek black look).
* **Icon:** Choose *Modern*, *Classic*, or upload a *Custom* icon.
* **Bubble Size**: Adjust the chat bubble to "Large" for better visibility.
* **Bubble Position**: Place the bubble where it’s most accessible—default to "Bottom Right" but fine-tune its position with precise left/right and up/down settings.

***

**6. Lead Collection Popup**

* **Title and Subtitle**: Personalize the prompt for email collection.\
  Example:
  * *Title*: "Leave your email for a 10% discount"
  * *Subtitle*: "You will receive the coupon code immediately"
* **Buttons**:
  * *Send Label*: "Send message"
  * *Skip Label*: "Skip" (for users who prefer not to share their email).
* **Placeholder Text**: Guide visitors with text like *"Email address."*

***

**7. Marketing Consent**

* Enable or disable the marketing consent option based on your strategy.
* Customize the message:\
  Example: *"I agree to receive marketing emails."*

***

8. **Chat Bubble Position**

* **Chat bubble button size**: Choose from "**Small**", "**Medium**", or "**Large**" to control the overall size of your chat widget.
* **Chat bubble button position**: Select from four corner positions: "**Bottom Center**" (default), "**Bottom Right**", **Bottom Left**", "**Top Right**", or "**Top Left**" to determine where your chat widget appears on the page.
* **Move Left/Right**: Fine-tune the horizontal position with pixel precision (**0-100px**) to adjust the bubble's distance from the selected corner.
* **Move Up/Down**: Fine-tune the vertical position with pixel precision (**0-100px**) to adjust the bubble's distance from the selected corner.
* **Z-index**: Control the stacking order of your chat widget on the page - higher values (like **1000**) place it above other elements, while lower values place it behind them. The default value of **999** works well for most websites, but increase it if your widget is being hidden behind other page elements.

***

### Example Setup

* **AI Name**: *Luca from \[BRAND NAME] | Online.*
* **Avatar**: A friendly photo of Luca with a smile.
* **Welcome Message**:\
  \&#xNAN;*"Hi there! I'm Luca, here to help. Ask me anything about our products or services."*
* **Predefined Messages**:
  * *"Track My Order"*
  * *"Need Product Info"*
  * *"Chat About Discounts."*
* **Widget Color**: Match your brand’s primary color (e.g., #FF5722 for orange).
* **Position**: Bottom right, 20px from the edges.
